about: Hand-written inputs for the quotation matcher. Invented text only: no book's words go in git. expected.json is generated from these by pipeline/matcher_fixtures.py, which runs pipeline/dossier.py; lib/matcher.ts must return the same. Each case says what it is for; expected.json says what the Python returns.

normalize.why: a word broken at a line end is joined
U+2010 counts as the hyphen, and spaces around the break go
a carriage return before the newline is whitespace
digits either side are not a broken word
the second letter is consumed by the first join, so b- is not joined
composition happens before joining, so a decomposed accent before the hyphen is a letter
Python counts ½ as a letter here
U+0085 is whitespace to Python, so it is part of the line break
U+FEFF is not whitespace to Python, so it stays
strip() removes U+0085 at the ends
runs of spaces, tabs and no-break spaces collapse
a line break with a carriage return becomes one space

key.why: curly quotes, guillemets and low quotes unified; U+201F is not in the map
en dash, em dash, U+2010 and U+2011 become -
İ lowercases to two characters, so it is kept
capital sharp s lowercases to one character
each sigma lowercased on its own
the Kelvin sign lowercases to k
a titlecase digraph lowercases to one character

b1.text:
PORTADA

Libro de prueba para el cotejo de citas
Índice general del volumen, con sus capítulos numerados en orden y sin más.

El archivo del horror fronterizo se construye con voces que
no aparecen en los documentos oficiales. La lechuza canta so-
bre el techo cuando alguien va a morir, dicen en el pueblo.

Las curanderas guardan un saber que la escritura colonial no supo
leer. Cada relato repite, con variaciones mínimas, la misma adverten-

cia: el territorio recuerda la violencia antes de que ocurra.
«La bruja no es un personaje», escribe el autor, «es una forma
de memoria».¹² Así termina el capítulo.

Second chapter. The haunted landscape is a repertoire of warnings,
and the owl is its most persistent messenger in the oral tradition

of the borderlands. Readers who expect a ghost story will find
instead a theory of historical trauma — one written in the idiom of folklore.

of the borderlands. Readers who expect a ghost story will find
instead a theory of historical trauma — one written in the idiom of folklore.

Hauntology names the persistence of what should have vanished. The
witch, the owl and the healer each persist in this sense, as figures of
an unfinished past.

Lejos del comienzo, el libro vuelve a una frase: la lechuza canta sobre
el techo cuando alguien va a morir, dicen en el pueblo de la frontera.
